headline: Tropical Depression Neneng Weakens East of Taiwan as Monsoon Relief Is Forecast
seoTitle: TD Neneng Weakens; Monsoon Relief Forecast | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News evening brief reports Tropical Depression Neneng slightly weakening east of Taiwan, with PAGASA forecasting gradual easing of Habagat rains over western Luzon.
deck: The weakening cyclone points toward improving conditions, although residual heavy rain and marine hazards remain possible.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News evening package, citing PAGASA, reports that Tropical Depression Neneng slightly weakened while east of Taiwan and continued moving toward Taiwan.
The package says forecasters expected the Southwest Monsoon to begin easing over Metro Manila and western Luzon on August 20, while localized heavy rain could still occur.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The package describes Neneng as likely to weaken further after interaction with Taiwan's terrain. Marine warnings remained relevant for northern and western Luzon.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Weather improvement can help flood recovery and transport normalization, but residual rainfall over saturated areas can still trigger localized hazards.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch PAGASA for the cyclone's downgrade or exit, updated rainfall outlooks and the lifting of marine warnings.
